Sara — thanks, this is exactly the right time to coordinate. I pulled together a short plan below and attached a small template (acme_sample_exports_v1.csv) you can use to drop in your sample rows. High-level proposal:

1) Preflight (this week)
   - You drop 10k sample rows using the CSV template. Include canonical_id, raw_text, title, and the top-3 metadata keys used by your ranking model.
   - We run a priming profiler to recommend quantization + shard counts.

2) Smoke eval (2-week sprint, early March)
   - Redwood runs rerank smoke using your 300 labeled pairs (or we provide a labeling cadence if you don’t have 300).
   - Metrics: MRR@10, p@1, 95th percentile token latency for top-k retrieval + reranker.

3) Index population (staging)
   - Phased hydration: seed-critical buckets first (top traffic categories), then bulk backfill during off-peak 48-hour window with throttled writers.

4) Cutover & rollback plan
   - Canary to 5% traffic for 24 hours, monitor quality regressions and cost delta; automatic fallback to existing retrieval if thresholds exceed tolerances.

Open questions for your side: retention requirements for sample exports, and whether you want us to provision a temporary dedicated vector DB instance (we can size a small Milvus cluster or recommend a managed provider).

I’ve copied Marissa to coordinate the technical runbook and Ben for timeline commitments. Next action: Sara — please upload the 10k sample to the Drive link below by EOD Monday and confirm who on legal we should include for retention notes.

Thanks,

Hi team — attaching a draft priming playbook (priming_playbook_draft.pdf) and an initial checklist. Key technical notes from our infra review:

- Vector DB choice: for your dataset size we recommend a managed Faiss-on-S3 pattern if you want lowest cost, or a small Milvus cluster if you need faster ingestion + replication. Pinecone is fine but will increase unit cost; we’ll provide concrete numbers once we see a sample distribution.
- Quantization: start with FP16 for staging, then try 8-bit dynamic quantization on a 10% slice to measure accuracy delta.
- Sharding/replicas: 3 shards with 2 replicas is a safe default for HA; can reduce to 2 shards for staging.
- Consistency: ensure the doc ID mapping and timestamp fields are normalized — our seeder uses canonical_id to reconcile duplicates during partial backfills.

Smoke eval specifics:
- We’ll spin a small rerank job (rerank-smoke-matrix.xlsx attached) using a templated workload: 1k queries sampled by traffic, 300 labeled Q-A pairs (if you don’t have labels we’ll propose a labeling sprint).
- Acceptance thresholds: MRR uplift >= 5% vs baseline or p@1 no worse than -1.5%; latency delta under 15% at p50.

Operational tasks I’ll take ownership of (Marissa):
- Validate sample export format and run priming profiler (Due: Wed 02/25)
- Deliver vector DB sizing options and cost delta (Due: Fri 02/27)

Sara — I also added Naomi from the success ops team to help with the staging runbook and backup/rollback.

Marissa
